bodyHtml:
The new Spindles United Blue Keeper Kit was celebrated last week with a photoshoot at the location of its inspiration.

The Cohoes Falls, stitched into the bright blue fabric of the 2024 Keeper Kit, is the second largest waterfall in New York State just behind Niagra Falls.

Since we started this club, it has always been clear that the history, landscape, and community of Cohoes will always be our foundation.

Featured in the shoot, Spindles Goalkeepers Papa Ndiaye and Josh Marer.

Within the kit, is base with a repeating light blue sillouette of the Cohoes Falls on the front and back.

Surrounding the shirt, is dark blue details and trim to show the wide range of color that rushing water is depicted as.

In the sponsor spots, proudly worn are the 2024 kit sponsors. Guth DeConzo, Primeau's Autobody, 7 Brothers Landscaping, and Bear Digital.

Detailed on the sleeves, the clubs favorite line "Up the Spins."

Opposite to that, our core value "A Club for the Community."

A special thank you to Mark Luciano of Brookfield Renewables U.S. for allowing us to access this natural wonder.

Watch the short kit video shot at the falls.
